metadata.description: A self-growing, cross-LLM toolkit: kickoff routing, judgment skills, agents and hooks, plus a curated profile of Anthropic, GitHub and partner plugins. Works in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (CLI, cloud agent, VS Code) and any Agent Skills client.

plugins.name: kickoff
plugins.description: The router. Classifies a task, loads the right skills, agents and plugin commands on whatever platform you are on, checks the catalog for gaps and existing plugins that fill them, then harvests reusable work back into the toolkit so it grows.

plugins.name: codemap
plugins.description: Token-efficient repository map and change review: a SQLite index of symbols, imports, references and packages with a ranked repo map, search, outlines, exact symbol source, refs/callers and impact queries, plus structural PR change maps (risk order, broken callers, test gaps, Mermaid/HTML views, AI-review packs). CLI + single-tool MCP server.

plugins.name: engineering-craft
plugins.description: Judgment skills for software work: understanding the problem, scoping, implementing, exploring code, architecture, debugging, testing, reviewing, refactoring, incidents and technical communication.

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Reasoning skills: first principles, systems thinking, probabilistic thinking, decisions, creativity, maths, scientific method, evaluating information and research.

plugins.name: communication-and-leadership
plugins.description: Skills for writing, teaching, presenting, persuading, hard conversations, meetings and leading a team.

plugins.name: life-and-career
plugins.description: Skills for career moves, self-management, focus, habits, learning, health, training, starting a business and personal finance.

plugins.name: doc-coauthor
plugins.description: Three-stage document co-authoring (context, draft, reader-simulation review) with isolated sub-agents. For RFCs, PRDs, decision docs, architecture specs and proposals.
